::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
**Neither source has been checked.** Both citations came across from
`PK_Choosing_Metric_public.Rmd` as links, and the page's characterization of
each is Andy's from the source file rather than a reading done here. The
bibliographic details below were fetched from Crossref and PubMed on
2026-09-02 and are correct; what is unverified is whether each paper says what
the page uses it to say.
:::

The page is
[Selecting an Exposure Metric](../../selecting-an-exposure-metric.qmd), the
working document is [the specification](specification.qmd), and the folder's
documents are on [the project index](index.qmd).

## Status markers

- ❌ **Not checked.** No claim on the page has been verified against this
  source.
- ⚠️ **Transcribed, unverified.** A number, table or figure on the page came
  from this source but has not been checked against it.
- ✅ **Checked.** The claim the page draws from it has been verified against
  the source.

Change a marker when the check is done, not when the paper is opened.

## Reading queue

Two entries, in the order to read them.

1.  ❌ **Ruiz-Garcia et al., 2023.** Read first. It is cited as the general
    companion to the whole page rather than for one claim, so reading it either
    confirms the page sits inside current practice or shows where it has drifted.
    Question to read against: does the review's account of exposure metric
    selection in oncology agree with the four questions, and does it name a
    consideration the page omits?

2.  ❌ **Dumortier et al., 2015.** Read second, and quickly. Only one claim
    depends on it and the claim is about a figure. Question to read against:
    does the paper show daily tacrolimus concentration with rejection events
    overlaid, and do most events fall below the median?

## Sources

**❌ Ruiz-Garcia A, Baverel P, Bottino D, Dolton M, Feng Y, González-García I,
et al. A comprehensive regulatory and industry review of modeling and
simulation practices in oncology clinical drug development.** *Journal of
Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics* 50:147--172, 2023.
[doi:10.1007/s10928-023-09850-2](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10928-023-09850-2)

Cited in the page's opening as a useful companion. Nothing on the page depends
on a specific number or figure from it, so the marker turns ✅ once the review
has been read against the question in the queue above.

**❌ Dumortier T, Looby M, Luttringer O, Heimann G, Klupp J, et al. Estimating
the contribution of everolimus to immunosuppressive efficacy when combined with
tacrolimus in liver transplantation: a model-based approach.** *Clinical
Pharmacology and Therapeutics* 97:411--418, 2015.
[PubMed 25669933](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25669933/)

Cited in Section 3 as the pattern for a time-dependent exposure metric. The
page describes a figure from it: daily tacrolimus concentration with organ
rejection events drawn in black, most of them below the median. That
description came across from the source R Markdown file and the figure itself
was not in the upload, so it is unverified in both senses. See Section 4 of
[the specification](specification.qmd).
